name: backdoor/attach-policy
description: Create an IAM role with AdministratorAccess trusted by the attacker's principal via CloudFormation template

options.name: ESCALATED_ROLE_NAME
options.description: Name for the new IAM role to create in the template. Auto-generated if not set

options.name: TRUST_PRINCIPAL
options.description: IAM principal ARN to trust in the escalated role's trust policy. Defaults to current caller ARN
